declared_canon_note: AOB = printed Abbreviations of Books (KoshaSHRI official PDF, re-OCR ground truth 14-10-2026), dictionary-wide, not letter-a. H6932 (18-10-2026) closes the band: the declared canon is the landed entry inventory data/pd/pd_aob_entries.tsv (H6720), 1,430 parsed rows, of which 7 are OCR junk -> 1,423 usable entries. The line-level reconciliation that ties it to H6923's R1 census is exact and asserted by scripts/pd_aob_declared_entries.py --selftest: 1,476 R1 entry-like lines - 165 dotless OCR wrap fragments + 119 printed entries R1 misses = 1,430 parsed = TSV rows; 1,430 - 7 junk = 1,423. Metric 2 = 118/1,423 = 8.29 % (8.3 %, one in twelve). The published artifact data/pd/pd_aob_declared_works.tsv carries 1,112 works / 1,118 edition rows and remains a clean-subset FLOOR, NOT the canon: 118/1,118 = 10.55 % overstates coverage and must never be quoted as the declared canon. The band [1,419,1,517] is kept as provenance only. Sources: data/pd/pd_aob_denominator_reconciliation.json, data/pd/pd_aob_entries.tsv, data/pd/pd_aob_declared_canon_audit.json.
